content:
julia_cs: Hey team, acme_ops reports Dashboard (Analytics -> Model usage) shows all zeros when they pick Region=eu-west-1 and select multiple model versions for a model. They say API metrics still show traffic. Screenshot: https://acme.screens/obv.png

sam_support: ack, can you paste exact steps/filters they used?

acme_ops: Steps: open Console -> Analytics -> Model usage. Filters: Region=eu-west-1, Model='redwood-gpt-large', Versions=[v2, v3]. Time range: Last 24h. Charts go to 0 immediately. If we clear Region, data returns.

julia_cs: They also mentioned a spike in API latency around the same time, but logs show normal request flow.

neil_eng: interesting. my hunch: filter normalization / multiselect interaction with region-scoped buckets. will try to repro locally. can you paste a minimal query or examples from their request logs?

acme_ops: here's a small snippet from their usage export (sanitized):

```
model,version,region,tokens
redwood-gpt-large,v2,eu-west-1,12000
redwood-gpt-large,v3,eu-west-1,8000
redwood-gpt-large,v2,us-east-1,15000
```

acme_ops: They still see counts in the CSV but dashboard is blank when the multi-version filter + region is set.

sam_support: @neil_eng any quick thought? Could be permissions / org defaults?

neil_eng: unlikely permissions since clearing region fixes it. I'm running the same filter against dev metrics store now. Quick smoke:

```
SELECT region, model, version, count(*)
FROM telemetry.metrics
WHERE region = 'eu-west-1'
  AND model = 'redwood-gpt-large'
  AND version IN ('v2','v3')
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
```

neil_eng: got 2 rows locally. On Console UI, UI code path converts multiselect into an OR filter but then applies a normalization that collapses version for cross-region joins. suspecting a regression from the normalization rollout last week. :eyes:

observability-bot: deploy-notice: normalization-service v1.14.0 deployed 3h ago to prod (config: collapse-version-on-join=true).

neil_eng: that matches the timing. If collapse-version-on-join removes the version key during the region join, the frontend will get back aggregated buckets that don't match the selected version set -> UI interprets as no matching buckets and shows zeros.

tara_product: customer impact high. Do we have a safe rollback?

neil_eng: I can flip the flag for the normalization service to false for prod immediately. Will coordinate with eng-infra. Temporary mitigation: ask customer to uncheck region or use single-version filter.

sam_support: pinging acme_ops with workaround.

acme_ops: workaround confirmed works for now (clearing region brings metrics back). Thanks.

neil_eng: rolling the flag back now.

observability-bot: action: normalization-service.flag.collapse-version-on-join set -> false by neil_eng at 1860001378

neil_eng: after rollback, console charts repopulated for the saved filter. acme_ops can you check your dashboard?

acme_ops: checked — charts show numbers again. latency chart still spiky but that looks separate.

tara_product: next actions: 1) revert the default collapse-version behavior in the next release or make multiselect+region safe. 2) add an integration test for version+region combos. 3) notify customers impacted by the 3h window.

julia_cs: I'll draft the customer note and send to acme_ops. Good catch everyone. :party_parrot:

neil_eng: file follow-up ticket ENG-analytics-952 with repro + fix plan. Will add regression test.

sam_support: marking this thread resolved for CS side, leaving eng follow-up.

acme_ops: thanks all!
